title: Ninth Word Fourth Point Reminders Of Afternoon Sunset And Night

questions.question: What season is the afternoon prayer time compared to?
questions.answer: It is compared to autumn.

questions.question: What stage of life is linked with the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: It is linked with old age.

questions.question: Which important time in Islamic history is connected to the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: It is connected to the time of the Final Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time make a person remember about living things?
questions.answer: It makes a person remember that many creatures leave and pass away.

questions.question: What human event does the sunset prayer time bring to mind?
questions.answer: It brings death to mind.

questions.question: What huge future event does the sunset prayer time also remind people of?
questions.answer: It reminds people of the world being destroyed when resurrection begins.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time awaken people from?
questions.answer: It awakens them from careless neglect.

questions.question: What does nightfall cover the daytime world with in this passage?
questions.answer: It covers it with darkness like a black covering.

questions.question: How is winter described in relation to the earth?
questions.answer: It is described as covering the dead earth like a white burial cloth.

questions.question: What happens even to the remaining works of people who have died?
questions.answer: They also fade away and are forgotten.

questions.question: How is this world described at nightfall?
questions.answer: It is described as a testing place that will one day be closed forever.

questions.question: What main idea do the examples of afternoon, sunset, and nightfall teach together?
questions.answer: They teach that these prayer times remind people of Allah’s power, mercy, glory, and the passing nature of worldly life.

questions.question: Which prayer time is compared to the later part of life?
questions.answer: The afternoon prayer time.

questions.question: Besides old age, what season does the afternoon prayer time resemble?
questions.answer: It resembles autumn.

questions.question: What does the afternoon prayer time help a believer remember about Allah?
questions.answer: It helps a believer remember Allah’s actions and kindness.

questions.question: Why is the sunset prayer time serious and powerful in meaning?
questions.answer: Because it reminds people of death, loss, and the great events at the end of the world.

questions.question: What does the passage say leaves at the end of autumn?
questions.answer: Many creatures leave and pass away.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time make a person think about at the start of resurrection?
questions.answer: It makes a person think about the destruction of the world.

questions.question: What feelings about Allah are connected to the sunset prayer time?
questions.answer: It brings to mind Allah’s greatness and majesty.

questions.question: What does the nightfall prayer time remind people about the daytime world?
questions.answer: It reminds them that darkness hides the things seen in daytime.

questions.question: What two kinds of covering are used to describe night and winter?
questions.answer: One is a black covering over the world, and the other is a white burial covering over the earth.

questions.question: What happens to human works over time, according to the nightfall example?
questions.answer: They disappear and sink into forgetfulness.

questions.question: What can a student infer from the world being called a place of testing?
questions.answer: Life is temporary, and people are being tried before an ending comes.

questions.question: What do all three prayer times have in common in this passage?
questions.answer: All of them remind people of change, endings, and Allah’s control over everything.

questions.question: What three comparisons are given for the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: It is compared to autumn, old age, and the blessed time of the Final Prophet, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What is remembered through those comparisons for the afternoon prayer time?
questions.answer: Allah’s acts and merciful gifts are remembered.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time remind a person about autumn?
questions.answer: It reminds a person that many creatures disappear at the end of autumn.

questions.question: How does the sunset prayer time connect to every human being personally?
questions.answer: It reminds each person of death.

questions.question: How does the sunset prayer time connect to the whole world?
questions.answer: It reminds people that the world will one day be destroyed.

questions.question: What wrong state of mind does the sunset prayer time shake a person out of?
questions.answer: It shakes a person out of heedlessness.

questions.question: What image is used for darkness at nightfall?
questions.answer: Darkness is pictured as covering the world like a black cloth.

questions.question: What image is used for winter at nightfall?
questions.answer: Winter is pictured as wrapping the earth like a white burial cloth.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens to the traces left by dead people?
questions.answer: Their traces fade away and are forgotten.

questions.question: What does the closing of the testing world suggest about worldly life?
questions.answer: It suggests that worldly life is not forever and will come to an end.

questions.question: Which prayer time most strongly points to forgetting and disappearance?
questions.answer: The nightfall prayer time.

questions.question: What is one big lesson a Muslim student can learn from this whole passage?
questions.answer: A Muslim should remember Allah, think about the Hereafter, and not become lost in worldly distractions.

questions.question: Which prayer time is linked with the season when leaves often fall and things begin to fade?
questions.answer: The afternoon prayer time.

questions.question: Which part of a person’s life matches that same prayer time?
questions.answer: The later years of life.

questions.question: What special historical age is also connected to that prayer time?
questions.answer: The age of the Final Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say the sunset prayer time recalls at the end of a season?
questions.answer: It recalls many creatures passing away at the end of autumn.

questions.question: What personal event and world event are both recalled at sunset?
questions.answer: A person’s death and the destruction of the world.

questions.question: What effect should sunset have on a careless person?
questions.answer: It should wake that person up from spiritual carelessness.

questions.question: What does nightfall do to the things seen during the day?
questions.answer: It hides them under darkness.

questions.question: How does the passage connect winter with death?
questions.answer: It says winter covers the earth in a way like a burial wrapping.

questions.question: According to the passage, do people’s works stay forever in this world?
questions.answer: No. They fade and pass into forgetfulness.

questions.question: What does the passage say will happen to this world as a place of testing?
questions.answer: It will be shut down forever.

questions.question: What attribute of Allah is especially shown at nightfall in this passage?
questions.answer: His mighty and overpowering rule.

questions.question: How do these prayer times help build strong faith?
questions.answer: They help people remember Allah’s power, the shortness of life, and the truth of the Hereafter.

questions.question: What does the afternoon prayer time resemble in nature, in human life, and in sacred history?
questions.answer: It resembles autumn, old age, and the time of the Final Prophet, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What do those afternoon reminders show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show His acts and merciful favors.

questions.question: What does the sunset prayer time teach by reminding us of creatures leaving?
questions.answer: It teaches that life in this world does not last.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect sunset with human death?
questions.answer: Because sunset is a time of ending, and death is also an ending in worldly life.

questions.question: How does sunset also point beyond one person’s life?
questions.answer: It points to the end of the whole world.

questions.question: What should happen to a person’s heart when sunset is understood correctly?
questions.answer: The heart should wake up and become more aware.

questions.question: What is one reason the nightfall prayer time feels heavy and serious in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it reminds people of darkness, loss, and the end of the testing world.

questions.question: What happens to the visible world at nightfall?
questions.answer: It becomes hidden by darkness.

questions.question: What happens to the earth in the winter image?
questions.answer: It is covered as if wrapped after death.

questions.question: What happens to the works left behind by dead people?
questions.answer: They do not remain fully present; they fade and are forgotten.

questions.question: What can we understand from the phrase that this world is a place of examination?
questions.answer: We are here for a test, not to stay forever.

questions.question: What is the best summary of the whole marked passage?
questions.answer: The prayer times of afternoon, sunset, and night remind people of aging, death, the end of the world, and Allah’s greatness and mercy.

questions.question: Name the three things the afternoon prayer time is said to be like.
questions.answer: It is like autumn, old age, and the blessed age of the Final Prophet, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What does the afternoon prayer time call to mind about Allah’s treatment of His servants?
questions.answer: It calls to mind His kindness and gracious gifts.

questions.question: What natural change is used at sunset to remind people of endings?
questions.answer: The passing away of many creatures at the end of autumn.

questions.question: What part of human life is remembered at sunset?
questions.answer: The end of life, which is death.

questions.question: What future event for the whole creation is remembered at sunset?
questions.answer: The destruction of the world at the beginning of resurrection.

questions.question: When the passage says sunset wakes people from heedlessness, what does that mean?
questions.answer: It means it helps them stop living carelessly and start remembering Allah and the Hereafter.

questions.question: At nightfall, what happens to the things people saw during the day?
questions.answer: They are hidden by darkness.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give of winter and the earth?
questions.answer: It gives the picture of the earth being covered like someone wrapped for burial.

questions.question: What does nightfall remind people about things made by those who died?
questions.answer: It reminds people that those things also pass away and are forgotten.

questions.question: What does the passage say will happen to the world as a testing ground?
questions.answer: It will one day be completely closed.

questions.question: Which prayer time in this passage most strongly points to the final closing of worldly life?
questions.answer: The nightfall prayer time.

questions.question: How are afternoon, sunset, and nightfall similar in the passage?
questions.answer: They all act like reminders that this world changes, people do not stay forever, and Allah is in complete control.
